corpus_title: IETF OAuth 2.0 & JWT Security Specifications Corpus
topic: Technical Specifications for OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange, JWT Best Current Practices, JWT Access Tokens, and Pushed Authorization Requests
page_counting_rule: Count physical PDF pages containing substantive technical specification text after Unicode NFKC normalization and running header/footer removal. Exclude pages containing only Table of Contents, only Bibliographic References, or only Acknowledgements / Authors' Addresses. Strip trailing TOC lines on Page 3 prior to Section 1. Introduction.

metadata_fields.document_id: str - RFC identifier (rfc8693, rfc8725, rfc9068, rfc9126)
metadata_fields.source: str - Relative path to source PDF in repository
metadata_fields.page: int - Physical page number in the PDF (1-indexed)
metadata_fields.year: int - Official IETF publication year (2020 or 2021), used for metadata filtering
metadata_fields.category: str - IETF RFC status category ('Standards Track' or 'Best Current Practice'), used for metadata filtering
metadata_fields.section: str - Primary numbered section heading on the page
